<!-- FORGE:INVESTIGATOR -->
## Investigation Report

### Verdict / Confidence / Severity / Task Type
- Verdict: confirmed
- Confidence: high
- Severity: medium
- Task type: correctness and regression-test fix

### Root Cause
The GitHub projector already has the required read-modify-replace behavior, but workflow-state derivation is split between a partial local helper in `src/agents/child-runtime.ts` and isolated parent terminal handling. Bounded checkpoint transitions therefore update only some labels, and the parent-owned merge lifecycle never projects `workflow:awaiting-merge` before merge or `workflow:merged` at merge completion.

### Evidence
- `src/core/artifact-protocol.ts` defines the canonical workflow label values but does not provide one shared checkpoint mapping.
- `src/agents/child-runtime.ts:1102-1132` maps only selected child starts and investigation completion; it has no merge mapping and relies on text matching for invalid investigation results.
- The checkpoint handler invokes the local mapping only for child checkpoint calls, while parent merge transitions use `appendPhase` in `src/workflows/work-on.ts` and do not call `setWorkflowLabel` at merge start/completion.
- `GitHubIssueProjector.setWorkflowLabel` filters all existing `workflow:*` labels and retains unrelated labels, so the projection primitive satisfies the replacement/preservation requirement and should be reused unchanged.
- Existing tests verify isolated label replacement and one exact label assertion, but do not exercise the complete checkpoint lifecycle or parent merge projections.

### Affected Files
- `src/core/artifact-protocol.ts` — add the shared action/phase-to-canonical-label mapping.
- `src/agents/child-runtime.ts` — replace the duplicate partial mapping with the shared helper.
- `src/workflows/work-on.ts` — project awaiting-merge when parent merge starts and merged after the merge effect succeeds.
- `test/core/artifact-protocol.test.ts` — cover every child lifecycle mapping and invalid-investigation branch.
- `test/adapters/github-projection.test.ts` — retain/extend replacement and unrelated-label preservation coverage if needed.

### Recommendation
Centralize checkpoint label derivation beside `WORKFLOW_LABEL_BY_STAGE`, preserve the current invalid-investigation classification, use the shared helper from bounded checkpoint handling, and explicitly call the existing projector at parent merge start and completion. Keep all label writes fail-closed and leave the projector's unrelated-label preservation semantics unchanged.

### Related Issues
- No duplicate implementation or open duplicate issue was found in the supplied issue context or read-only repository state.

### Decomposition Assessment
The change is coherent and bounded to label derivation, parent merge projection, and focused tests. No product, UX, protected-branch, or security-authority decision is required.

### Acceptance Spec
- Every child phase start receives the canonical current workflow label.
- Investigation completion selects ready-to-build or invalid from the existing report classification.
- Parent merge start projects workflow:awaiting-merge; successful merge completion projects workflow:merged.
- Each projection removes stale workflow:* labels while preserving unrelated labels.
- Automated tests cover the full mapping and replacement behavior without adding external side effects.
